# Supplementary tables (generated by scripts/supp_tables.py)

Census time-to-loss numbers use the vendors' published retirement dates as the event (every identifier in the census has one; nothing is censored); 'km_median_months' is the Kaplan-Meier median censored at 2026-10-12, the estimand of the earlier versions, and 'lost_by_today_pct' the share lost by that date. The origin is the publication date, with year-only dates (printed by OpenAlex as 1 January) placed at 1 July and papers dated before the release of the first-retiring identifier started at that release. Born-dead papers name a model that was already retired at the origin; they are excluded from the curves and reported separately.
